default.$description: Solé primary action fill in light mode. Figma component `button`, variant Property 4=Indigo (Sistema de diseño Solé).

hover.$description: Same as default until design defines a hover state. Figma component `button`, variant Property 4=Indigo (Sistema de diseño Solé).

active.$description: Same as default until design defines a pressed state. Figma component `button`, variant Property 4=Indigo (Sistema de diseño Solé).

foreground.$description: Text and icons on the Solé primary action in light mode. Figma component `button`, variant Property 4=Indigo (Sistema de diseño Solé).
